title: 高層建築斜交網格結構~High-rise diagrid structures
focus: 以斜柱軸力同時抵抗重力與側力的斜交網格：斜角取捨、樓板環向繫材、節點、施工幾何與耐火維護~Diagrids that carry gravity and lateral load through diagonal axial force: angle trade-offs, floor hoop ties, nodes, erection geometry and fire upkeep
summary: 以紐約赫斯特大樓、倫敦聖瑪莉艾克斯 30 號與廣州國際金融中心為例，從斜柱角度如何在剪力與彎曲勁度之間取捨、樓板如何以環向拉力平衡斜柱外推力出發，處理螺栓與焊接節點、鋼管混凝土斜柱，再到斜柱逐層安裝的穩定與測量控制、節點原型試驗、以實測週期驗證勁度，最後是外露斜柱的耐火防蝕與改裝管控。~Using the Hearst Tower in New York, 30 St Mary Axe in London and the Guangzhou International Finance Center as examples, start from how the diagonal angle trades shear against bending stiffness and how floors balance the diagonals' outward thrust with hoop tension, handle bolted and welded nodes and concrete-filled tube diagonals, then the stability and survey control of erecting inclined members, node prototype tests and stiffness verification from measured periods, ending with fire and corrosion upkeep of exposed diagonals and control of alterations.

units.title: 斜交網格的軸力傳力與角度取捨~Axial load paths and the angle trade-off
units.mechanism: 斜交網格以外圍的斜柱同時承擔重力與側力，構件主要受軸力而非彎矩，因此用鋼量比一般的柱梁構架少；公開資料指出赫斯特大樓的斜交網格比同規模的傳統設計少用約兩成鋼材。斜柱的角度決定它對兩種勁度的貢獻：抵抗剪力時，較平的斜柱水平分量大；抵抗整體彎曲（傾覆）時，較陡的斜柱垂直分量大。高樓越細長，彎曲越主導，最佳角度就越陡，實務上多落在約 60° 到 75° 之間。~A diagrid carries gravity and lateral load through perimeter diagonals that act mainly in axial force rather than bending, so it uses less steel than a conventional column-and-beam frame; public sources state that the Hearst Tower diagrid used about 20% less steel than a comparable conventional design. The diagonal angle sets the contribution to two kinds of stiffness: flatter diagonals have more horizontal component to resist shear, while steeper ones have more vertical component to resist overall bending, or overturning. The more slender the tower, the more bending governs and the steeper the optimum angle, typically between about 60° and 75° in practice.
units.model: 單根斜柱在模組高 h 內的勁度：剪力方向 k_h = (EA/h)·sinθ·cos²θ，彎曲（垂直）方向 k_v = (EA/h)·sin³θ。sinθcos²θ 在 θ ≈ 35.3° 時最大（0.385），θ = 60° 時 0.217、69° 時 0.120；sin³θ 在 60° 時 0.650、69° 時 0.814、75° 時 0.901。角度由 60° 變陡到 69°，彎曲勁度增加約 25%，剪力勁度卻減少約 45%。~Stiffness of one diagonal over a module height h: in shear k_h = (EA/h)·sinθ·cos²θ, and in bending (vertical) k_v = (EA/h)·sin³θ. sinθcos²θ peaks at θ ≈ 35.3° (0.385) and is 0.217 at 60° and 0.120 at 69°; sin³θ is 0.650 at 60°, 0.814 at 69° and 0.901 at 75°. Steepening from 60° to 69° raises bending stiffness by about 25% but cuts shear stiffness by about 45%.
units.verify: 以初步模型比較數種斜角與模組高度（例如 2、4、6 層一組）的頂部變位、用鋼量與節點數量，並分別輸出剪力變形與彎曲變形的比例，確認選定的角度讓兩者都在合理範圍；同時檢查角度是否與樓層高度、帷幕分割與節點製造相容。~Compare several angles and module heights, for example two, four or six storeys per module, in a preliminary model for top drift, steel tonnage and number of nodes, separating shear and bending deformation to confirm that the chosen angle keeps both reasonable; check also that the angle suits storey heights, façade panelling and node fabrication.
units.failure: 若只追求最少鋼材而選擇過陡的斜柱，剪力勁度不足，樓層間會出現較大的剪切變形，帷幕與隔間受損；角度過平則傾覆勁度不足，頂部擺動與角落斜柱軸力都會偏大。~Choosing over-steep diagonals purely for minimum steel leaves too little shear stiffness, producing large inter-storey shear deformation that damages the façade and partitions; too flat an angle leaves too little overturning stiffness, increasing top sway and corner-diagonal forces.
units.misconception: 斜交網格的角度只是建築造型的選擇，對結構效率沒有影響。~The diagrid angle is purely an aesthetic choice with no effect on structural efficiency.
units.practice: 在設計基準書中記錄斜角與模組高度的比選過程與依據，並明列剪力與彎曲變形的分配；建築若要調整模組或斜角，須回到結構顧問重新評估用鋼量與勁度。~Record the angle and module-height comparison and its rationale in the design basis, stating the split between shear and bending deformation; any architectural change to module or angle must return to the structural consultant to reassess tonnage and stiffness.

units.anchor: 樓板環向繫材~Floor hoop ties
units.title: 斜柱外推力與樓板環向拉力~Diagonal outward thrust and floor hoop tension
units.mechanism: 在斜交網格中，重力沿著傾斜的構件往下傳，兩根斜柱在節點相交時，垂直分量相加傳給下方，水平分量則把節點往外推。這個外推力必須由該層的樓板或周邊環梁以拉力平衡，否則節點會向外移動、整個網格失去形狀。對圓形或曲面平面的建築，例如聖瑪莉艾克斯 30 號的全三角化周邊結構，周邊環梁就像箍桶的鐵箍，承受環向拉力；樓板在這些樓層必須連續，不能被大開口切斷。~In a diagrid, gravity runs down inclined members; where two diagonals meet at a node their vertical components add and pass down, while their horizontal components push the node outwards. That outward thrust must be balanced in tension by the floor or perimeter ring beam at that level, otherwise the node moves out and the grid loses its shape. For circular or curved plans, such as the fully triangulated perimeter of 30 St Mary Axe, the perimeter ring works like a hoop on a barrel, carrying ring tension; floors at these levels must be continuous and not cut by large openings.
units.model: 節點外推力 H = P/(2·tanθ)。節點重力 P = 10 MN、θ = 69°（tanθ ≈ 2.605），H ≈ 10/(2×2.605) ≈ 1.92 MN；圓形平面節點間距 s = 6 m 時，環向等效分布外推力 q = 1.92/6 ≈ 0.32 MN/m，半徑 R = 25 m 的環向拉力 T = q·R ≈ 8.0 MN。數值為教學假設。~Node outward thrust H = P/(2·tanθ). With a node gravity load P = 10 MN and θ = 69° (tanθ ≈ 2.605), H ≈ 10/(2×2.605) ≈ 1.92 MN; on a circular plan with nodes s = 6 m apart the equivalent radial load is q = 1.92/6 ≈ 0.32 MN/m, so a ring of radius R = 25 m carries hoop tension T = q·R ≈ 8.0 MN. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 在結構模型中輸出每個節點樓層的環梁拉力與樓板面內應力，確認樓板與環梁連接能傳遞外推力；施工期間樓板尚未澆置時，以臨時繫材或先行的鋼環梁承擔外推力，並量測節點的水平位移是否在容許範圍內。~Output ring-beam tension and in-plane slab stresses at every node level from the structural model and confirm that slab-to-ring connections can transmit the thrust; during construction, before slabs are cast, carry the thrust with temporary ties or early steel ring beams and measure node horizontal movement against tolerance.
units.failure: 若節點樓層的樓板被挑空或大開口切斷，環向拉力無法連續傳遞，節點向外移位，斜柱與帷幕的幾何隨之變形；施工期間若在樓板完成前移除臨時繫材，節點可能在自重下外張。~If a node floor is cut by an atrium or large opening, hoop tension cannot pass continuously, the nodes move outwards and the geometry of diagonals and façade distorts; removing temporary ties before slabs are complete during construction can let nodes spread under self-weight.
units.misconception: 斜交網格的樓板只承受樓面載重，與斜柱的穩定無關。~Floors in a diagrid only carry floor loads and have nothing to do with the diagonals' stability.
units.practice: 在結構圖上標示所有承受環向拉力的樓層與環梁，並註明「此層樓板不得開設大開口」；臨時繫材的拆除順序列為施工停止點，須在樓板達到設計強度並經結構工程師確認後才可拆除。~Mark every floor and ring beam carrying hoop tension on the structural drawings with a note that no large openings may be cut in these slabs; make the removal sequence of temporary ties a construction hold point, allowed only after slabs reach design strength and the structural engineer confirms.

units.anchor: 螺栓與焊接節點~Bolted and welded nodes
units.title: 斜交網格節點的設計與製作~Design and fabrication of diagrid nodes
units.mechanism: 節點是斜交網格中受力最集中、也最昂貴的部分：多根斜柱、環梁與樓板梁在同一點相交，每根構件的軸力方向不同，節點必須把它們平衡並傳給下一層。做法大致分為工廠焊接的鋼板節點、鑄鋼節點，以及工廠預製後在現場以高強度螺栓接合的節點；公開資料指出赫斯特大樓的斜柱在節點處以螺栓而非焊接連接，以加快高空施工並減少現場焊接的品質風險。螺栓節點的關鍵是摩擦面與預拉力，焊接節點的關鍵則是厚板焊接的韌性與殘留應力。~Nodes are where diagrid forces concentrate and where most of the cost lies: several diagonals, ring beams and floor beams meet at one point, each with axial force in a different direction, and the node must balance them and pass them to the next level. Approaches include shop-welded plate nodes, cast-steel nodes and shop-fabricated nodes joined on site with high-strength bolts; public sources note that the Hearst Tower diagonals are bolted rather than welded at the nodes, speeding erection at height and reducing the quality risk of site welding. For bolted nodes the keys are faying surfaces and pretension; for welded nodes, the toughness and residual stress of thick-plate welds.
units.model: 摩擦型螺栓抗滑 F_s = k_s·n·μ·F_p,C/γ。M30、10.9 級：F_p,C = 0.7×1,000×561 ≈ 392.7 kN；μ = 0.5、雙剪 n = 2、k_s = 1、γ = 1.25，F_s ≈ 1×2×0.5×392.7/1.25 ≈ 314 kN；斜柱軸力 12 MN 需 12,000/314 ≈ 38.2，取 40 支。數值為教學假設。~Slip resistance of a preloaded bolt F_s = k_s·n·μ·F_p,C/γ. For M30 grade 10.9, F_p,C = 0.7×1,000×561 ≈ 392.7 kN; with μ = 0.5, two slip planes n = 2, k_s = 1 and γ = 1.25, F_s ≈ 1×2×0.5×392.7/1.25 ≈ 314 kN, so a 12 MN diagonal force needs 12,000/314 ≈ 38.2, rounded up to 40 bolts. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 螺栓節點須確認摩擦面處理與抗滑係數試驗、螺栓預拉力（以扭矩或轉角法施工並抽驗）；焊接或鑄鋼節點則以有限元素分析求熱點應力，厚板焊接做超音波檢測，鑄鋼件做超音波與磁粒檢測並核對材料韌性。~For bolted nodes confirm faying-surface preparation with slip-coefficient tests and bolt pretension, installed by torque or turn-of-nut and spot-checked; for welded or cast nodes obtain hot-spot stresses by finite-element analysis, ultrasonically test thick-plate welds, and test castings ultrasonically and by magnetic particle inspection while checking material toughness.
units.failure: 摩擦面若被油漆或油污污染，抗滑係數下降，節點在風的反覆作用下滑動，造成螺栓承壓與孔壁磨損；厚板焊接節點若有未熔合或層狀撕裂，可能在地震或疲勞作用下由節點內部開裂。~Faying surfaces contaminated with paint or oil lose slip coefficient, so nodes slip under repeated wind loading, putting bolts into bearing and wearing hole walls; thick-plate welded nodes with lack of fusion or lamellar tearing can crack from inside under earthquake or fatigue loading.
units.misconception: 斜交網格的節點只要比構件強就好，細部不重要。~Diagrid nodes only need to be stronger than the members; details do not matter.
units.practice: 節點製造前做試作件並經設計者確認；螺栓節點的摩擦面保護、預拉力施作與檢驗列入檢驗計畫，焊接節點的焊接程序、預熱與檢測比例明列；每個節點以編號追蹤製造、檢驗與安裝紀錄。~Make trial nodes for the designer's approval before production; put faying-surface protection, pretensioning and inspection of bolted nodes into the inspection plan, specify welding procedures, preheat and inspection rates for welded nodes, and track every node by number through fabrication, inspection and installation records.

units.anchor: 鋼管混凝土斜柱~Concrete-filled tube diagonals
units.title: 鋼管混凝土斜柱的勁度與耐火~Concrete-filled diagonals for stiffness and fire
units.mechanism: 超高層斜交網格的斜柱軸力極大，廣州國際金融中心採用鋼管混凝土斜柱，直徑由底部約 1,800 mm 漸減到頂部約 900 mm，網格每 12 層形成高約 54 m 的菱形節點，並與核心筒組成筒中筒。管內混凝土大幅提高軸向勁度與受壓容量，並抑制鋼管向內挫屈；混凝土的熱容量也延緩鋼管升溫，但公開資料指出主要構材仍另外施作兩小時的防火被覆。斜放的鋼管讓混凝土澆置與排氣比垂直柱更困難。~Diagrid diagonals in a supertall tower carry huge axial forces; the Guangzhou International Finance Center uses concrete-filled steel tube diagonals that taper from about 1,800 mm in diameter at the base to about 900 mm at the top, with the grid forming nodes every 12 storeys in diamonds about 54 m tall, combined with the core as a tube-in-tube. The concrete fill greatly raises axial stiffness and compressive capacity and prevents the tube buckling inwards; its thermal mass also slows heating of the steel, though public sources note that two-hour fire protection was still applied to the primary structure. Inclined tubes make concrete placement and venting harder than in vertical columns.
units.model: 合成軸向勁度 EA = E_s·A_s + E_c·A_c。D = 1.8 m、t = 50 mm：A_s = π×1.75×0.05 ≈ 0.275 m²、A_c = π×1.7²/4 ≈ 2.27 m²；E_s = 200 GPa、E_c = 38 GPa，EA ≈ 55.0×10⁹ + 86.3×10⁹ ≈ 141×10⁹ N，混凝土提供約 61% 的軸向勁度，總勁度約為空鋼管的 2.6 倍。厚度與模數為教學假設。~Composite axial stiffness EA = E_s·A_s + E_c·A_c. For D = 1.8 m and t = 50 mm, A_s = π×1.75×0.05 ≈ 0.275 m² and A_c = π×1.7²/4 ≈ 2.27 m²; with E_s = 200 GPa and E_c = 38 GPa, EA ≈ 55.0×10⁹ + 86.3×10⁹ ≈ 141×10⁹ N, so the concrete supplies about 61% of the axial stiffness and the total is about 2.6 times that of the empty tube. Thickness and moduli are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 斜管澆置前以足尺斜置模型試灌，切開檢查管頂與節點附近的空洞，確定澆置孔、排氣孔與自充填配比；正式施工以敲擊或超音波抽查，並記錄每段的澆置量與理論體積比對；防火被覆以厚度量測與附著試驗驗收。~Before production, cast a full-scale inclined mock-up and cut it open to check voids along the crown and near nodes, fixing placement holes, vent holes and the self-consolidating mix; during construction spot-check by tapping or ultrasonic testing and compare each segment's placed volume with the theoretical volume; accept fire protection by thickness measurement and adhesion tests.
units.failure: 斜置鋼管的頂側容易積存空氣與泌水，形成長條狀空洞，該段的合成勁度與鋼管的挫屈約束都下降；若以為混凝土填充已足夠防火而省略被覆，火災中鋼管升溫失去強度，斜柱軸力轉移到相鄰構件。~Inclined tubes collect air and bleed water along the upper side, forming long voids that reduce composite stiffness and the restraint against tube buckling; omitting fire protection on the belief that the fill is enough lets the tube heat up and lose strength in a fire, shifting diagonal force to neighbouring members.
units.misconception: 鋼管內灌了混凝土，就不需要另外做防火被覆。~A tube filled with concrete needs no separate fire protection.
units.practice: 斜管的澆置方向、排氣孔位置與澆置速度寫入施工計畫，每段設「模型試灌合格」與「前段檢測完成」兩個停止點；防火被覆的耐火時效依整體防火策略決定，不以填充混凝土替代，並由防火與結構工程師共同簽認。~Write placement direction, vent-hole positions and placement rate for inclined tubes into the construction plan, with two hold points per segment, mock-up approval and completion of checks on the previous segment; set fire-protection ratings from the overall fire strategy rather than relying on the fill, signed jointly by the fire and structural engineers.

units.anchor: 斜柱安裝的臨時支撐~Temporary support of inclined members
units.title: 斜柱逐段安裝的穩定與臨時支撐~Stability and temporary support while erecting inclined members
units.mechanism: 斜交網格只有在三角形閉合後才穩定；安裝過程中，一根剛吊上的斜柱只有下端接合，另一端懸空，自重就會讓它傾倒並在下端接合產生彎矩。施工時必須以臨時支撐、纜索或先行安裝的環梁把斜柱拉住，直到相鄰斜柱與環梁組成閉合三角形。安裝順序要讓每一個階段的未完成網格都是穩定的，並考慮施工期間的風力與吊裝碰撞。~A diagrid is stable only once its triangles close; during erection a freshly lifted diagonal is joined only at its lower end with the other end free, and its own weight tends to tip it over, inducing moment in the lower connection. Temporary struts, cables or ring beams installed in advance must hold the diagonal until neighbouring diagonals and ring beams form a closed triangle. The erection sequence must keep every incomplete stage of the grid stable, allowing for construction wind and lifting impacts.
units.model: 單根斜柱的傾倒彎矩 M = W·(L/2)·cosθ。重 15 t（W ≈ 147 kN）、長 L = 17 m、θ = 69°：M ≈ 147×8.5×0.358 ≈ 448 kN·m；若以上端的臨時水平支撐抵抗，支撐力 R = M/(L·sinθ) ≈ 448/(17×0.934) ≈ 28 kN，另加施工風力與吊裝衝擊係數。數值為教學假設。~Tipping moment of a single diagonal M = W·(L/2)·cosθ. For a 15 t member (W ≈ 147 kN), L = 17 m and θ = 69°, M ≈ 147×8.5×0.358 ≈ 448 kN·m; resisted by a temporary horizontal brace at the top, the brace force is R = M/(L·sinθ) ≈ 448/(17×0.934) ≈ 28 kN, plus construction wind and a lifting-impact factor. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以施工階段分析檢查每個安裝步驟中未完成網格的穩定性與臨時支撐受力，臨時支撐與其錨定點須有計算書；每根斜柱就位後量測上端座標，確認在容許偏差內才可鬆鉤，閉合三角形後才可拆除臨時支撐。~Check the stability of the incomplete grid and the temporary-support forces at every erection step with a construction-stage analysis, backed by calculations for each support and its anchorage; measure the top coordinates of every diagonal after placement and release the hook only when within tolerance, removing temporary supports only after the triangle closes.
units.failure: 若在臨時支撐未就位前鬆鉤，斜柱可能傾倒並撞擊下方構件與人員；臨時支撐若錨定在未達強度的樓板或尚未鎖緊的構件上，強風時整片未完成網格可能變形甚至倒塌。~Releasing the hook before temporary supports are in place can let a diagonal topple onto members and workers below; supports anchored to under-strength slabs or not-yet-tightened members can let a whole incomplete section of grid distort or collapse in strong wind.
units.misconception: 斜柱是斜的，所以會自己靠在結構上，不需要臨時支撐。~Diagonals lean, so they rest against the structure on their own and need no temporary support.
units.practice: 吊裝計畫要列出每一根斜柱的安裝順序、臨時支撐位置與鬆鉤條件，並規定風速上限；每一個閉合單元完成前設停止點，由鋼構工程師確認臨時支撐與座標後才可安裝下一根。~The lifting plan lists the installation order of every diagonal, temporary-support positions, hook-release conditions and the wind-speed limit; set a hold point before each closed unit is completed, at which the steel engineer confirms supports and coordinates before the next member goes in.

units.anchor: 節點座標與累積誤差~Node coordinates and accumulated error
units.title: 斜交網格的測量控制與誤差累積~Survey control and error accumulation in a diagrid
units.mechanism: 斜交網格的幾何由節點座標決定，帷幕單元、樓板邊緣與環梁長度都依節點位置預先製造；一旦節點位置偏差累積，上方的斜柱長度與角度就無法吻合。與垂直柱不同，斜柱的長度誤差會同時造成水平與垂直偏移，而且相鄰節點的偏差會互相牽動。測量控制必須分辨隨機誤差（各節點獨立）與系統誤差（如測量基準偏移、溫度或焊接收縮造成的同方向偏差），後者會線性累積，是最危險的。~A diagrid's geometry is set by its node coordinates, and façade units, slab edges and ring-beam lengths are fabricated in advance from those positions; once node deviations accumulate, the lengths and angles of diagonals above no longer fit. Unlike vertical columns, a length error in a diagonal produces both horizontal and vertical offsets, and deviations at adjacent nodes interact. Survey control must distinguish random errors, independent at each node, from systematic errors, such as datum drift or same-direction offsets from temperature or weld shrinkage; the latter accumulate linearly and are the most dangerous.
units.model: 誤差累積：每一模組節點的隨機誤差 σ = 3 mm、共 8 個模組時，總誤差約 3×√8 ≈ 8.5 mm；若同樣 3 mm 是系統性偏差，總誤差為 3×8 = 24 mm，接近三倍。因此每一模組都要回到固定基準重新定位，而不是以前一層為基準往上累加。數值為教學假設。~Error accumulation: with a random node error σ = 3 mm per module over 8 modules, the total is about 3×√8 ≈ 8.5 mm; if the same 3 mm is systematic, the total is 3×8 = 24 mm, nearly three times as much. Every module must therefore be set out again from fixed datums rather than built up from the level below. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 建立獨立於結構的控制網，每一模組完成後以全測站量測所有節點座標，並在溫度均勻的時段量測；把實測座標與考慮自重、溫度與焊接收縮的預測座標比較，偏差趨勢呈同方向時立即檢討原因並調整上方構件的製造尺寸。~Establish a control network independent of the structure, survey every node with a total station after each module in thermally uniform conditions, and compare measured coordinates with those predicted including self-weight, temperature and weld shrinkage; when deviations trend in one direction, investigate at once and adjust the fabrication dimensions of members above.
units.failure: 若每層都以下層節點為基準往上放樣，系統誤差會一路累積，到上部時預製的帷幕單元與斜柱無法安裝，只能現場修改或重新製造；節點間距誤差也會使環梁拉力分布不均。~Setting out each level from the nodes below lets systematic error accumulate upwards until prefabricated façade units and diagonals no longer fit, forcing site modification or refabrication; errors in node spacing also make ring-beam tension uneven.
units.misconception: 只要每根斜柱都在工廠做準，現場就不需要逐模組量測。~If every diagonal is made accurately in the shop, no module-by-module survey is needed on site.
units.practice: 測量計畫規定固定基準點、量測時段、各模組的容許偏差與趨勢判斷規則；量測結果即時回饋給鋼構製造廠與帷幕廠，作為後續構件尺寸調整的依據，修正量由結構工程師核可。~The survey plan fixes datum points, measurement windows, module tolerances and trend rules; feed results back immediately to the steel fabricator and façade supplier as the basis for adjusting later member sizes, with corrections approved by the structural engineer.

units.anchor: 節點足尺試驗~Full-scale node tests
units.title: 節點原型試驗與應力集中驗證~Node prototype tests and stress-concentration checks
units.mechanism: 斜交網格節點的幾何複雜，多向受力下的應力集中與塑性發展很難只靠計算確定，因此重要專案常以足尺或大比例原型試驗驗證。試驗以多支油壓千斤頂模擬各斜柱的軸力比例，在設計載重的倍數下量測熱點應變、變形與破壞模式，確認節點強度高於相連構件，並驗證有限元素模型的應力集中係數。試驗結果也用來決定生產節點的檢驗重點。~Diagrid nodes are geometrically complex, and stress concentration and plastic development under multi-directional loads are hard to establish by calculation alone, so major projects often verify them with full-scale or large-scale prototype tests. Several hydraulic jacks reproduce the proportions of the diagonal forces, and hot-spot strains, deformations and failure modes are measured at multiples of the design load to confirm that the node is stronger than the connected members and to validate the stress concentration factors of the finite-element model. The results also set the inspection focus for production nodes.
units.model: 應力集中係數 SCF = σ_熱點/σ_名目。原型在 1.5 倍設計載重下名目應力 200 MPa、熱點量得 480 MPa（尚在彈性範圍），SCF = 480/200 = 2.4；有限元素預測 2.3，差約 4%，可接受。若量得 SCF 3.0，熱點處的疲勞壽命以應力三次方估計將降為約 (2.4/3.0)³ ≈ 51%。數值為教學假設。~Stress concentration factor SCF = σ_hot/σ_nominal. At 1.5 times design load a prototype with 200 MPa nominal stress shows 480 MPa at the hot spot, still elastic, so SCF = 480/200 = 2.4; the finite-element prediction of 2.3 is within about 4%, which is acceptable. Had the SCF been 3.0, fatigue life at the hot spot, scaling with stress cubed, would fall to about (2.4/3.0)³ ≈ 51%. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 試驗計畫先由設計者、試驗室與第三方審查，規定載重比例、加載步驟、應變計位置與停止條件；試驗後比較實測與預測的應變分布、剛度與破壞位置，並將差異納入生產節點的檢驗重點與焊接要求。~Have the designer, laboratory and a third party review the test plan beforehand, fixing load ratios, loading steps, strain-gauge locations and stop criteria; afterwards compare measured and predicted strain distributions, stiffness and failure location, and carry any differences into the inspection focus and welding requirements for production nodes.
units.failure: 若跳過原型試驗而直接量產，節點中某個未被模型捕捉的應力集中點可能在風的反覆作用下產生疲勞裂縫；試驗若只加單向載重而未重現多向受力比例，也可能錯估節點真正的弱點。~Skipping prototype tests and going straight to production can leave a stress concentration the model missed to start fatigue cracks under repeated wind loading; tests that apply load in only one direction without reproducing the multi-directional force ratios can also misjudge where the node is truly weak.
units.misconception: 有限元素分析已經夠精確，節點不需要做試驗。~Finite-element analysis is precise enough that nodes need no testing.
units.practice: 對重複數量多或受力最大的節點型式安排原型試驗，試驗通過列為量產前的停止點；試驗報告、應變資料與照片納入竣工文件，作為日後檢查與疲勞評估的基準。~Schedule prototype tests for the most repeated or most heavily loaded node types, making a passed test a hold point before production; include the test report, strain data and photographs in the as-built documents as the baseline for later inspection and fatigue assessment.

units.anchor: 實測週期與勁度驗證~Measured period and stiffness check
units.title: 以環境振動驗證斜交網格的勁度~Verifying diagrid stiffness from ambient vibration
units.mechanism: 斜交網格的側向勁度主要來自斜柱的軸向勁度與節點的實際剛度，模型中節點偏心、螺栓滑動、樓板參與與非結構構件都會影響結果。完工後以環境振動量測建築的前幾個模態週期，是驗證整體勁度最直接的方法：週期比預測短代表實際較勁，可能是帷幕與隔間參與；週期比預測長則可能是節點或接合比假設柔。量測結果用來校正模型，作為日後評估改裝與事件後狀態的基準。~A diagrid's lateral stiffness comes mainly from the diagonals' axial stiffness and the actual rigidity of the nodes, and node eccentricity, bolt slip, slab participation and non-structural elements all affect the model result. Measuring the first few modal periods by ambient vibration after completion is the most direct check of overall stiffness: a period shorter than predicted means the building is stiffer, perhaps with façade and partitions participating, while a longer period may mean nodes or joints are softer than assumed. The measurements calibrate the model as a baseline for later assessment of alterations and post-event condition.
units.model: 由 T = 2π√(m/k) 得 k ∝ 1/T²。若預測週期 4.4 s、實測 4.0 s，實際勁度約為預測的 (4.4/4.0)² ≈ 1.21 倍；若實測 4.8 s，則只有 (4.4/4.8)² ≈ 0.84 倍，代表節點或接合可能比模型柔，須進一步檢查。數值為教學假設。~From T = 2π√(m/k), k ∝ 1/T². If the predicted period is 4.4 s and the measured one 4.0 s, actual stiffness is about (4.4/4.0)² ≈ 1.21 times the prediction; a measured 4.8 s gives only (4.4/4.8)² ≈ 0.84 times, suggesting nodes or joints softer than modelled and calling for further checks. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 在頂層與中間樓層兩個方向及角落設置加速度計，長時間記錄並以兩種識別方法求週期與振型；先確認質量假設（實際裝修與設備重量），再以勁度修正模型使週期吻合，並檢查修正後的變位與構件力是否仍符合要求。~Install accelerometers in both directions and at corners on the top and intermediate floors, record for long periods and identify periods and mode shapes by two methods; first confirm the mass assumptions, including actual fit-out and equipment, then adjust stiffness so the model matches the periods, and check that drifts and member forces still comply after updating.
units.failure: 若量得週期明顯偏長卻未追查，可能隱藏節點螺栓未達預拉力或接合滑動的問題，在強風中逐漸惡化；若把偏短的週期全部歸功於結構而忽略非結構構件，改裝拆除隔間後勁度會下降，舒適度變差。~Ignoring a markedly longer measured period can hide nodes with under-tensioned bolts or slipping joints that worsen in strong winds; crediting a shorter period entirely to the structure and ignoring non-structural elements means stiffness drops when partitions are removed in a refit, worsening comfort.
units.misconception: 週期量測只是學術研究，對結構驗收沒有意義。~Period measurement is merely academic and means nothing for structural acceptance.
units.practice: 把完工後的環境振動量測列入驗收項目，報告附原始資料、識別方法與校正後的模型參數；大規模改裝前後各量測一次，以確認勁度變化是否在可接受範圍。~Make post-completion ambient vibration measurement an acceptance item, with raw data, identification methods and calibrated model parameters in the report; measure again before and after any major refit to confirm that stiffness changes are acceptable.

units.anchor: 外露斜柱耐火被覆~Fire protection of exposed diagonals
units.title: 外露斜柱的耐火與防蝕維護~Fire protection and corrosion upkeep of exposed diagonals
units.mechanism: 斜交網格的斜柱常是建築造型的一部分，在室內或帷幕後方外露，業主希望看得到鋼構，因此多採用薄層膨脹型防火塗料而非厚重的噴覆。斜柱一旦在火災中失去強度，傳力路徑會重新分配，但每根斜柱都同時承擔重力與側力，冗餘度有限；防火被覆的厚度要依構件的斷面係數決定，斷面越厚實，需要的塗層越薄。靠近帷幕的斜柱還可能受到冷凝水與溫度變化影響，塗層的完整性需要長期維護。~Diagrid diagonals are often part of the architecture, exposed inside or behind the glazing, and owners want the steel visible, so thin intumescent coatings are favoured over heavy sprayed protection. If a diagonal loses strength in a fire the load path redistributes, but each diagonal carries both gravity and lateral load, so redundancy is limited; coating thickness is set by the member's section factor, with stockier sections needing thinner coatings. Diagonals next to the façade may also see condensation and temperature swings, so coating integrity needs long-term upkeep.
units.model: 斷面係數 H_p/A = 受熱周長/斷面積。600 mm 方管、厚 40 mm：A = 0.6² − 0.52² ≈ 0.0896 m²、H_p = 2.4 m，H_p/A ≈ 26.8 m⁻¹，屬於厚實斷面，所需膨脹塗層較薄；若改為 H_p/A ≈ 150 m⁻¹ 的薄壁構件，同樣耐火時效需要的塗層會厚得多。數值為教學假設。~Section factor H_p/A = heated perimeter over cross-sectional area. A 600 mm square box with 40 mm walls has A = 0.6² − 0.52² ≈ 0.0896 m² and H_p = 2.4 m, so H_p/A ≈ 26.8 m⁻¹, a stocky section needing a relatively thin intumescent coat; a thin-walled member with H_p/A ≈ 150 m⁻¹ would need a much thicker coat for the same fire rating. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 防火塗料的厚度依經認證的厚度表與實際斷面係數決定，施工後以乾膜厚度計逐構件量測並記錄；營運中定期目視檢查塗層破損、剝離與鏽斑，帷幕附近加強檢查冷凝區域，任何碰撞損傷都要依原規格修補並重新量測。~Set fire-coating thickness from certified loading tables and the actual section factor, and after application measure dry-film thickness member by member and record it; in service inspect periodically for coating damage, delamination and rust spots, giving extra attention to condensation zones near the façade, and repair any impact damage to the original specification with re-measurement.
units.failure: 裝修或設備安裝時刮傷、鑽孔或在斜柱上焊接附掛物，會破壞防火塗層且不易被發現，火災時該處成為弱點；冷凝水長期滲入塗層下方則造成鋼材腐蝕與塗層剝落，同時削弱防火與結構斷面。~Scratching, drilling or welding attachments to diagonals during fit-out or equipment installation damages the fire coating in ways that are easily missed, creating weak points in a fire; long-term condensation under the coating corrodes the steel and lifts the coating, weakening both fire protection and the structural section.
units.misconception: 防火塗料塗一次就能永久有效，不需要檢查。~A fire coating, once applied, lasts for ever and needs no inspection.
units.practice: 交接文件附每根斜柱的編號、斷面係數、耐火時效、塗層產品與乾膜厚度紀錄；營運手冊規定任何在斜柱上的鑽孔、焊接或附掛都必須事先申請，完成後依原規格修補並由防火與結構工程師確認。~Handover documents give every diagonal's number, section factor, fire rating, coating product and dry-film thickness records; the operations manual requires prior approval for any drilling, welding or attachment on diagonals, with repair to the original specification confirmed by the fire and structural engineers.

units.anchor: 改裝時的斜柱與樓板保護~Protecting diagonals and slabs in refits
units.title: 租戶改裝與斜交網格的交接管控~Tenant refits and handover controls for a diagrid
units.mechanism: 斜交網格的每一個構件都同時參與重力與側力傳遞，而節點樓層的樓板又承擔環向拉力，因此租戶改裝時常見的動作，例如在樓板開設樓梯或挑空、在斜柱旁增設夾層、或切割環梁穿管，都可能直接影響主結構。交接時必須把「哪些構件與樓板是網格系統的一部分」清楚告訴營運單位，並建立改裝審查流程；帷幕更換或外牆清洗設備的固定點若設在斜柱上，也要經結構確認。~Every diagrid member takes part in both gravity and lateral load paths, and node-level floors carry hoop tension, so common tenant refit actions, such as cutting stair openings or atria in slabs, adding mezzanines beside diagonals or cutting ring beams for services, can directly affect the primary structure. Handover must make clear to the operator which members and slabs belong to the grid system and establish an alteration review process; fixings for façade replacement or cleaning equipment attached to diagonals also need structural confirmation.
units.model: 環向拉力所需鋼筋 A_s = T/(φ·f_y)。T = 8.0 MN、φ = 0.9、f_y = 420 MPa，A_s ≈ 8.0×10⁶/(0.9×420) ≈ 21,160 mm²；若改裝開口切斷樓板繫筋的 40%，須以補強鋼環梁或新增鋼筋補足約 0.4×21,160 ≈ 8,470 mm² 的拉力面積。數值為教學假設。~Reinforcement for hoop tension A_s = T/(φ·f_y). With T = 8.0 MN, φ = 0.9 and f_y = 420 MPa, A_s ≈ 8.0×10⁶/(0.9×420) ≈ 21,160 mm²; if a refit opening cuts 40% of the slab tie bars, a supplementary steel ring beam or added bars must restore about 0.4×21,160 ≈ 8,470 mm² of tension area. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 改裝申請須附結構圖套繪，標出受影響的樓板繫筋、環梁與斜柱；以掃描或鋼筋探測確認開口位置的鋼筋配置，補強完成後由結構工程師現場驗收，並更新竣工圖與結構管制圖。~Alteration requests must overlay the structural drawings, marking affected slab ties, ring beams and diagonals; confirm the reinforcement at the proposed opening by scanning or cover-meter survey, have the structural engineer accept the strengthening on site and update the as-built and structural control drawings.
units.failure: 未經審查在節點樓層開設挑空，環向拉力傳遞中斷，節點緩慢外移並造成帷幕接縫開裂；在斜柱上焊接夾層支架則可能造成熱影響區脆化與防火塗層破損，形成難以察覺的隱患。~Cutting an atrium on a node floor without review interrupts hoop tension, letting nodes creep outwards and crack façade joints; welding mezzanine brackets to diagonals can embrittle the heat-affected zone and damage the fire coating, creating hidden hazards.
units.misconception: 斜交網格的樓板只是一般樓板，租戶可以自由開孔。~Diagrid floors are ordinary slabs that tenants may cut freely.
units.practice: 交接文件包含斜交網格系統圖、節點樓層與環梁清單、禁止開孔區域圖與改裝審查流程；租約中明定結構管制條款，任何涉及斜柱、環梁或節點樓層的工程須經結構工程師簽認後才可施作。~Handover documents include the diagrid system drawing, lists of node floors and ring beams, no-opening zone plans and the alteration review procedure; leases state the structural control clauses, and any work touching diagonals, ring beams or node floors proceeds only after the structural engineer signs off.

example: 斜交網格初步選角練習：某高 180 m、平面 36 m 見方的辦公塔，以 4 層一組的斜交網格抵抗側力，每個面有 n = 6 根斜柱，設計基底剪力 V = 10 MN、均布風載下基底彎矩 M = V·H/2 = 10×180/2 = 900 MN·m。剪力由兩個腹面承擔：斜柱軸力 N_s = V/(2n·cosθ)；彎矩由翼面以力偶承擔：翼面合力 F = M/B = 900/36 = 25 MN，每根斜柱垂直分量 25/6 ≈ 4.17 MN，軸力 N_b = 4.17/sinθ。θ = 69° 時 N_s ≈ 10/(12×0.358) ≈ 2.33 MN、N_b ≈ 4.46 MN；θ = 60° 時 N_s ≈ 1.67 MN、N_b ≈ 4.81 MN。以容許應力 207 MPa 估算，69° 時彎曲控制的斜柱需約 21,600 mm²、剪力只需約 11,200 mm²；改為 60° 時彎曲需求增加約 8% 至約 23,200 mm²，剪力需求降為約 8,100 mm²。細長塔由彎曲控制，因此較陡的角度通常較省鋼；若建築改為更矮胖的比例，剪力比重上升，最佳角度就會變平。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際建築的設計。~Preliminary diagrid angle study: a 180 m office tower, 36 m square, resists lateral load with a four-storey diagrid of n = 6 diagonals per face; the design base shear is V = 10 MN and under uniform wind the base moment is M = V·H/2 = 10×180/2 = 900 MN·m. Shear is carried by the two web faces, giving diagonal force N_s = V/(2n·cosθ); the moment is carried as a couple by the flange faces, with a flange resultant F = M/B = 900/36 = 25 MN, a vertical component of 25/6 ≈ 4.17 MN per diagonal and axial force N_b = 4.17/sinθ. At θ = 69°, N_s ≈ 10/(12×0.358) ≈ 2.33 MN and N_b ≈ 4.46 MN; at θ = 60°, N_s ≈ 1.67 MN and N_b ≈ 4.81 MN. At an allowable stress of 207 MPa, the bending-governed diagonal at 69° needs about 21,600 mm² while shear needs only about 11,200 mm²; at 60° the bending demand rises about 8% to about 23,200 mm² and the shear demand falls to about 8,100 mm². A slender tower is governed by bending, so steeper angles usually save steel; a squatter building, with shear more important, would favour a flatter optimum. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real building.
history: 以斜向構件組成網格的結構可追溯到 19 世紀末俄國工程師舒霍夫的雙曲面與網殼結構，而現代高層建築的斜交網格在 2000 年代成為重要的抗側系統：倫敦聖瑪莉艾克斯 30 號（2003 年完工、2004 年啟用）以 Arup 設計的全三角化周邊結構形成曲面外形，紐約赫斯特大樓（2006）以四層一組的斜交網格建在 1928 年歷史建築的立面之上，廣州國際金融中心（2010）則以鋼管混凝土斜柱把斜交網格推上 438.6 m 的超高層。斜交網格以軸力取代彎矩，節省鋼材並形成開放的室內空間，但也把複雜度集中在節點與施工幾何。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。~Structures built from grids of diagonal members trace back to the hyperboloid and lattice-shell works of the Russian engineer Vladimir Shukhov in the late nineteenth century, while modern high-rise diagrids became an important lateral system in the 2000s: 30 St Mary Axe in London (completed 2003, opened 2004) uses Arup's fully triangulated perimeter structure to form its curved shape, the Hearst Tower in New York (2006) raises a four-storey-module diagrid above the façade of a 1928 landmark, and the Guangzhou International Finance Center (2010) carries a diagrid of concrete-filled tubes to 438.6 m. Diagrids replace bending with axial force, saving steel and opening up interiors, but they concentrate complexity in the nodes and in erection geometry. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.
